decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ MODIFY already updates the code-location copy to include display directly on the NFT, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
The referral code was already required in NFT metadata; adding direct display on the NFT is a separate presentation surface and does not change the existing metadata attributes.
Changing where the referral code is displayed does not alter the commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or limit.
The referral-code display-surface change does not alter commission allocation when no referral code is entered.
Referral-code display surfaces do not change badge triggers, milestones, or on-chain award recording.
Referral-code display surfaces do not affect random selection, ticket weighting, VRF execution, or verification.
Adding a referral-code display surface does not change which entitlements, identity, badges, or tickets transfer on resale.
The referral-code display change does not alter mint pricing or any revenue-allocation destination or amount.
Referral-code display surfaces do not change Big Block prize amounts, draw triggers, eligibility, ticket reset behavior, or pool funding.
The display location of a referral code does not alter manual prize claiming, the one-click action, or the Winners page location.
Referral-code display surfaces do not change Small Block prize amounts, draw cadence, ticket eligibility, reset behavior, or funding.
The referral-code display change does not alter the Winners page as the winner-announcement channel.
